heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
Division 9—Change in ownership of international registration
text: This Division applies if the Registrar receives notification from the International Bureau of a change of ownership of the international registration of a trade mark that is the subject of an IRDA or is a protected international trade mark. Note: Change of ownership is defined in regulation 17A.2 to include assignment or transmission.
